product_fit.rationale: Market-leading purpose-built parametric SLA/availability and cloud-outage products for non-damage BI.

capital_reinsurance.rationale: Lloyd's coverholder backed by major A-rated insurers; precise capacity not public.

pricing_modelling.rationale: Parametrix Analytics models outage frequency/severity and correlation on large proprietary dataset.
